relationships.subject: SB-705498
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 antagonist SB-705498 produced significant results in increasing the heat pain threshold in treated skin

relationships.subject: JNJ-17203212
relationships.evidence_quote: one study reported inhibition of pain behavior in osteoarthritis (OA) mice after intra-articular administration of JNJ-17203212, a TRPV1 antagonist

relationships.subject: primidone
relationships.evidence_quote: Primidone, a clinically approved antiepileptic, is a TRPM3 antagonist

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: cannabidiol (CBD) is another molecule that has been tested to modulate TRPV1 to observe its role in analgesic pathways

key_findings: Review: TRPM, TRPV and TRPC channels are implicated in pain, neuropsychiatric disorders and epilepsy.
TRPV1 antagonism is linked to analgesia and anxiolysis, while TRPV1 agonism is pro-convulsant.
